# Infra Atlas

> Reference data for the infrastructure stack — cloud regions, instance types, API gateways, managed Kubernetes — cross-referenced across AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI and OVHcloud. Free, no ads, no vendor money. Every cell cites an official vendor documentation page. Cloud-compute data refreshes daily from public sources; cross-cloud matrices are dated, hand-verified snapshots.

Data is CC BY 4.0; the data endpoints below are CORS-enabled JSON, no key needed. For agents: prefer the data endpoints over scraping the HTML — they are the source of truth the pages render from.

## Data endpoints (JSON, refreshed daily unless noted)

- [EC2 instance types](https://infraatlas.dev/ec2/data.json): AWS instance families × regions, vCPU/memory/on-demand USD price per size
- [Azure VM sizes](https://infraatlas.dev/azure-vm/data.json): VM series × regions, specs and pay-as-you-go USD prices
- [OCI compute shapes](https://infraatlas.dev/oci-compute/data.json): Oracle Cloud shapes × regions with USD prices
- [OVHcloud instances](https://infraatlas.dev/ovh-instances/data.json): instance ranges × datacenters with EUR prices
- [GCP machine types](https://infraatlas.dev/gcp-compute/data.json): machine families × regions (curated; no prices)
- [Cloud regions](https://infraatlas.dev/regions/data.json): every GA region for the 5 clouds, with city/area/partition (curated)
- [Egress pricing](https://infraatlas.dev/egress/data.json): data-transfer price tiers for AWS/Azure/GCP (curated)
- [Change feed](https://infraatlas.dev/feed.json): regions/families/instance types added or removed, per refresh
- Per-instrument change feeds: the same shape filtered to one cloud — /ec2/feed.json, /regions/feed.json, /azure-vm/feed.json, /gcp-compute/feed.json, /oci-compute/feed.json, /ovh-instances/feed.json
- [API documentation](https://infraatlas.dev/api/): how the endpoints fit together

## Instruments (interactive reference pages)

- [EC2 Observatory](https://infraatlas.dev/ec2/): every EC2 instance type by region, filter by family/arch/price
- [Multi-Cloud Region Map](https://infraatlas.dev/regions/): all regions of the 5 clouds on one chart
- [Azure VM Atlas](https://infraatlas.dev/azure-vm/): Azure VM sizes by region
- [GCP Compute Index](https://infraatlas.dev/gcp-compute/): GCP machine types by region
- [OCI Compute Observatory](https://infraatlas.dev/oci-compute/): Oracle Cloud shapes by region
- [OVH Instance Catalogue](https://infraatlas.dev/ovh-instances/): OVHcloud instances by datacenter
- [Equivalent-SKU Finder](https://infraatlas.dev/equivalent-sku/): pick an instance on one cloud, get the closest match on every other, with a transparent score, list price and region count
- [Kubernetes Atlas](https://infraatlas.dev/kubernetes/): EKS vs AKS vs GKE vs OKE vs OVH managed Kubernetes
- [APIM Feature Matrix](https://infraatlas.dev/apim-matrix/): AWS API Gateway, Apigee, MuleSoft, Kong, Gravitee, IBM compared
- [AWS API Gateway Atlas](https://infraatlas.dev/aws-api-gateway/): REST vs HTTP vs WebSocket, authorizers, stages, limits — the deep-dive
- [Apigee Atlas](https://infraatlas.dev/apigee/): Google Apigee X/Hybrid/Edge — policies, proxies, KVMs
- [MuleSoft Atlas](https://infraatlas.dev/mulesoft/): Anypoint, CloudHub, RTF, Flex Gateway, DataWeave
- [Self-Hosted APIM](https://infraatlas.dev/self-hosted-apim/): Kong vs Gravitee vs IBM API Connect
- [Compliance Footprint](https://infraatlas.dev/compliance/): certifications (FedRAMP, ISO, SOC, HIPAA, PCI, GDPR…) per cloud
- [European Sovereignty](https://infraatlas.dev/sovereignty/): sovereign-cloud offerings, jurisdiction and EUCS/DPF status
- [Confidential Computing](https://infraatlas.dev/confidential-computing/): SGX/SEV/SNP/TDX/Nitro TEE per cloud
- [IAM Matrix](https://infraatlas.dev/iam-matrix/): identity and access models across the 4 hyperscalers
- [Generative AI Atlas](https://infraatlas.dev/ai-atlas/): Bedrock vs Vertex vs Azure Foundry vs OCI GenAI and model families
- [Networking Matrix](https://infraatlas.dev/networking-matrix/): VPC/VNet/VCN primitives translated across clouds
- [Egress & Transfer Cost Map](https://infraatlas.dev/egress/): what data transfer actually costs, with the footnotes
- [Observability Matrix](https://infraatlas.dev/observability/): CloudWatch vs Azure Monitor vs Cloud Monitoring vs OCI APM + OTel
- [Observability Stacks](https://infraatlas.dev/observability-stacks/): Prometheus/Grafana/Loki/Tempo/ELK/SigNoz self-hosted options
- [IDP Matrix](https://infraatlas.dev/idp-matrix/): Backstage, Roadie, Port, Cortex, OpsLevel, Compass compared neutrally
- [Data Layer Equivalence](https://infraatlas.dev/data-layer/): managed database/storage equivalents across clouds
- [Service Quotas](https://infraatlas.dev/service-quotas/): the default quotas that bite during scaling — vCPUs, concurrency, VPCs, IPs, buckets, roles, clusters — adjustable-vs-hard marked, with the raise path per cloud
- [Storage Pricing](https://infraatlas.dev/storage-pricing/): object storage cost across S3, Azure Blob, GCS, OCI and OVHcloud — storage by tier plus retrieval fees, minimum durations, restore latency, egress and per-request charges, all sourced

## Decision guides

- [Decisions hub](https://infraatlas.dev/decisions/): 11 sourced "which one do I use" guides (Fargate vs EC2, Aurora vs RDS, REST vs HTTP API, NAT options, sovereign cloud legal vs operational…)

## Calculators

- [Cross-Cloud TCO Comparator](https://infraatlas.dev/tools/tco/): the monthly bill for a workload on every cloud — equivalent SKUs, compute hours plus egress
- [Right-Sizing Calculator](https://infraatlas.dev/tools/right-size/): enter an instance and its real utilisation — get the cheaper instances that still fit, same cloud and cross-cloud
- [Egress Cost Calculator](https://infraatlas.dev/tools/egress-cost/): estimate a transfer bill across AWS/Azure/GCP
- [Subnet Calculator](https://infraatlas.dev/tools/subnet/): CIDR planning for VPC/VNet/VCN
- [APIM Limits Picker](https://infraatlas.dev/tools/apim-limits/): rate/payload/timeout limits per API platform

## Optional

- [About & methodology](https://infraatlas.dev/about/): how data enters the atlas, verification tiers, freshness policy
- [Changelog](https://infraatlas.dev/changelog/): what changed, refresh by refresh (also as RSS at /feed.xml)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/ineslino/infra-atlas): source, issues, "report a fix"
